title: Your own pitch names the thread after the investor, never after you

objects.subject: Kitebird - seed round
objects.body:
Hi Ira,

Kitebird is raising a seed round to bring AI scheduling to small clinics - 14 are live. Would you take a look at our deck this week?

Meera

notes: STEP-04. Production: the founder's own pitch threads were named '<the founder> - <the pitch>' (the business claim's sender, whatever the direction) and never renamed. The acceptance checks the thread's name.
blocked_on: the founder's own sent mail is captured but yields no signal, so it never reaches memory and the decision not to card it is never made — STEP-05
